senses.gloss: --a son of Suhotri, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १२७.
--a son of महावीर्य and father of Tray- यारुणि and others; attained ब्रह्मणगति; see दुरुक्षय. भा. IX. २१. १९-20.
--born of Krodha and हिम्सा; sister and also wife of Kali. भा. IV. 8. 3-4.
--see दुरितक्षय. According to मत्स्य पुराण the name is उरुक्षय. Vi. IV. १९. २४. [page२-100+ ३५]
--a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८६.
--a R. from the Vindhyas. M. ११४. २८.

--fortified places unknown under पृथु; six kinds of: Giridurga is the best; described.
1: M. १०. ३२; २१७. 6-८७; V. I. 6. १८.
also four kinds of; three natural and one artificial; contain different outways; कुमारिपुरम्, villages, towns surrounded by a moat, also mountains and rivers;
2: वा. 8. ९८, १०८ ff.
desert, mountain and water; man left the tree home for this; last was artificial; made by man with ramparts, moats and कुमारिपुरम्;
3: Br. II. 7. ९२, १०१ ff.
of the southern country.
4: वा. ४५. १२८.
(II)--a R. originating from the Vindhya Moun- tains. Br. II. १६. ३३; वा. ४५. १०३.
--a commander of भण्ड; a son of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८३; २६. ४९.
--the superintendent of fortresses; his qualifications. M. २१५. ३९. [page२-101+ २७]
--a territory to the west of the Vindhya Mountains. Br. II. १६. ६०.
--a son of Dana. भा. VI. 6. ३१.
--a son of Ananta (आनर्त-म्। प्।); a soldier of great fortune. Br. III. ६९. ५४; M. ४३. ४९; वा. ९४. ५३.
(I)--(Durmada): a son of Vasudeva and रोहिणि and father of अभिभूत. Br. III. ७१. १६५, १७१; M. ४६. १२; वा. ९६. १६३; Vi. IV. १५-22.
(II)--the son of धृत and father of Pra- cetas. Br. III. ७४. ११. वा. ९९. ११.
(III)--a king and a son of रुद्रश्रेणि. M. ४३. ११.
(IV)--a son of सुहोत्री, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १२७.
(V)--the surviving son of भद्रश्रेणि out of his hundred sons, who were put to sword by दिवोदास. वा. ९२. ६३.
(VI)--the son of भद्रश्रेण्य and father of Dhanaka. Vi. IV. ११. १०.
(VII)--a son of घृत and father of Pracetas. Vi. IV. १७. 4. [page२-102+ ३१]
--the son of शतानीक and father of वही- nara. भा. IX. २२. ४३.
--a Deva. Br. II. १३. ९५.
--a Mountain in भारतवर्ष. Br. II. १६. २०.
(II)--a Mind-born mother. M. १७९. १४.
(I)--a companion of पुरञ्जन, allegori- cally उपस्थ। भा. IV. २५. ५२; २९. १४.
(II)--a son of Bhadrasenaka (or Bhadra- sena) and father of Dhanaka. (Kanaka-ब्र्। प्।). भा. IX. २३. २३; Br. III. ६७. ६६; ६९. 7.
(III)--(see Durdama) a son of रोहिणी and Vasudeva. भा. IX. २४. ४६-47.
(IV)--a son of Vasudeva and पौरवी. भा. IX. २४. ४७. [page२-103+ २६]

(V)--an Asura commander of ten अक्षौ- हिणिस् was sent against ललिता accompanied by noisy पटह; rode on the camel, succeeded in taking a jewel from the crown of सम्पत्करी-Sarasvati, who being enraged struck him at the breast; he fell dead and his followers were mas- sacred. The rest fled to the सून्यक city in fear. Br. IV. २२. १९, २८, ४७.
(VI)--a name of विघ्नेश्वर. Br. IV. ४४. ६८.
(VII)--a son of भद्रश्रेणि; (see Dur- dama). वा. ९४. 7.
(VIII)--of the रोहिणि family; see also Dur- dama; a son of रोहिणि and आनकदुन्दुभि. वा. ९६. १६९; Vi. १५. १९.
--the son of धृत and father of Pracetas. भा. IX. २३. १५.
--fought with कामदेव in the देवासुर war. भा. VIII. १०. ३३.
--a son of शृञ्जय and राष्ट्रपालि. भा. IX. २४. ४२.
--the son of पुष्पमिष्ट. भा. XII. 1. ३४.
(I)--a राक्षस killed in the लङ्का war. भा. IX. १०. १८. [page२-104+ ४८]
(III)--a son of खश and a राक्षस. Br. III. 7. १३६; वा. ६९. १६७.
(IV)--a विघ्ननायक. Br. IV. २७. ८१.
(V)--a son of सुहोत्री, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १२७.

--a son of देवयानि; cursed by his father for refusing to part with his youth.
1: Vi. IV. १०. 6, १३.
Viceroy of south-east king- dom;
2: Ib. IV. १०. ३१.
line of; father of Vanhi; got merged into Puru's line ultimately.
3: Ib. IV. १६. 2-6.
--(दूर्वाक्षी-ब्र्। प्।) the queen of वृक. भा. IX. २४. ४३.

(I)--a son of Atri and an younger brother of दत्तात्रेय;
1: भा. IV. 1. १५; Br. III. 8. ८२; वा. ७०. ७६.
an अम्श of शिव;
2: भा. IV. 1. ३३.
appeared before अम्बरीष who was about to break his द्वादसि fast; agreed to accept his hospitality, went to the river for bath and tarried there; finding the मुहूर्त for पारण (break-fast) drawing to a close, the king broke his fast with some water. Coming to know of this on his return, the sage produced a flaming spirit to attack him. But Hari's चक्र burnt it down and turned towards the sage, who ran for succour to ब्रह्मा, शिव and विष्णु. All of them were unable to help; but Hari advised him to meet अम्बरीष and apologise to him.
3: Ib. IX. 4. ३५-71.
This he did and was set at liberty. After partaking the meals with him, he returned to Brahmaloka;
4: Ib. IX. 5. 1-२२.
blessed पृथ with secret मन्त्रस् to summon gods.
5: Ib. IX. २४. ३२; XI. 1. १२.
Through him Duryodhana planned to destroy the पाण्डवस् by inciting him to go to them and ask for a feast. But कृष्ण protected them on the occasion.
6: Ib. I. १५. ११.
In the course of his sojourn he met a विद्या- [page२-106+ २३] dhara maid with a garland given to her by the देवी; took it from her and presented it to Indra who put it on his elephant, who in turn threw it on the ground and trampled upon it. Enraged at this, the sage cursed him to be lost to all fortune.
7: Ib. VIII. 5. १६; Br. IV. 5. १६-20; 9. ३१; ४०. १२०.
(II)--a Siddha. भा. VI. १५. १३.
(III)--one of the Sages who left for पिण्डा- raka. भा. XI. 1. १२.
--a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८७.

(I)--a plant sacred to Hari;
1: भा. V. 3. 6.
from this दूर्वञ्- janam, being an auspicious thing to be looked at in the morning.
2: Br. III. २८. १०.
(II)--a son of नृपञ्जय: his son Timi. भा. IX. २२. ४२.
